lxc_c0a95fd2992cc75e.text: Read a short About Me reading about Ken.

lxc_bd3b0bf953022c77.text: Then use the same talk with blanks.

lxc_93b08173ff70c236.text: An About Me talk can begin with a name and a home city.

lxc_43d4e060e84a74e4.text: It can also name who lives with you.

lxc_84d7e9a955136726.text: These details give the listener a clear picture of your home life.

lxc_ed79a1b9f3e203c6.text: He lives in Osaka with his wife.

lxc_c08e78af2ae477b8.text: Osaka is a city in Japan.

lxc_607f9ce562552fb3.text: In the second sentence, the word “with” adds another person to the picture of Ken’s home.

lxc_f9e6cf45af5681c3.text: Next, Ken talks about his normal week.

lxc_120931e1084a074b.text: Then he moves from busy time to free time.

lxc_1b52b7bbf3b6a92d.text: He works at a small camera shop.

lxc_e97b528cb91c1859.text: When he has free time, he likes walking.

lxc_29fbe5c7162ed927.text: He also likes taking photos, because the streets are quiet.

lxc_4cfdfbeeb63f526c.text: Ken does not only name what he likes.

lxc_589e5457ec78f1c2.text: He also explains why he likes taking photos.

lxc_a2695744ac26956f.text: He begins with things he does often.

lxc_da61e9b86352e58f.text: Then he adds something he does only sometimes.

lxc_52e874ff6cfadec5.text: After that, he names a favorite place and gives two reasons.

lxc_6294fcbb0b73a113.text: On weekends, he usually walks and drinks coffee.

lxc_7462751d28082478.text: Sometimes he goes to a park with his wife.

lxc_8881b41fd194beb6.text: His favorite place is Osaka Castle park, because the walk is easy and the trees are nice.

lxc_8c463768813a84a1.text: Osaka Castle is a castle and park in Osaka.

lxc_c259ff89385f0349.text: An interest can have a story behind it.

lxc_197a6b3ad2536cf0.text: Ken first names something he likes.

lxc_bc4e5c7c26c06bfc.text: Then he explains how that interest began.

lxc_abea574a39e93cb2.text: He finishes with something he does now.

lxc_50c7ca09ce896b07.text: He started to like them because his father had one.

lxc_3e29226330a67fdd.text: These days, he takes photos of the river.

lxc_7ff83c05fb0cc3e6.text: “Started to like” looks back to the beginning.

lxc_cb3f958bf31d467b.text: “These days” brings the talk back to Ken’s life now.

lxc_052d45518cc025f0.text: Ken talks about a place he wants to visit.

lxc_5323ca82bb177301.text: He also names something new he wants to try and explains why it sounds fun.

lxc_d660a64785f753cd.text: Later, he wants to visit Kyoto for a weekend.

lxc_091e7988f0e938ee.text: One thing he wants to try is a night photo class.

lxc_300b08878a6faa5b.text: He thinks it would be fun because city lights look different at night.

lxc_0ddeb1c411bd549c.text: Kyoto is a city in Japan.

lxc_f9b8dee7770309d9.text: Words such as “later” and “wants to” show that these are future plans.

lxc_af422e094944b068.text: Now use the same order for your own talk.

lxc_2108685c51c91e5a.text: This lesson shape keeps the facts in order, then gives you blank About Me lines.

lxc_2f6338d784b79e92.text: Add your information to each blank.

lxc_18dc4a3c21a890eb.text: First read the lines as they are.

lxc_ffefdc98a8b3754b.text: I became interested in it because ________.

lxc_70bf0c5bef57e9c3.text: In the future, I would like to ________.

lxc_850a5ec65ed7360e.text: One thing I want to learn or try is ________.

lxc_6700b232cd885bdc.text: I think it would be interesting because ________.
